# Built-in Rules

<!-- Generated by crates/kingfisher-rules/build.rs. Do not edit manually. -->

Kingfisher embeds **484 rules** from the Betterleaks and Veles sources. Of these,
**245** include validation and **34** support direct revocation.
The catalog includes **46 hidden component/helper rules** used to assemble composite
credentials.

`Yes` means the operation is embedded in the current build. `None` means the rule detects findings
but does not provide that operation.
